svg.title: Goldbach v1.1.0 · Figure 3 · The Normal Form And The Host, Proved
svg.text: FIGURE 3
THE NORMAL FORM AND THE HOST, PROVED
GOLDBACH · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
THE NORMAL FORM · THE RECORD, THE TRANSFER, THE VALUE
THE RECORD
The registration keeps every even number and
forgets which split realizes it; on the record the
value holds with no premise.

svg.text: THE TRANSFER · THE ONE BIT
The value of a frame is exactly the transfer of
the value from its record to the frame: the
antecedent a theorem, the implication the
whole content.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE VALUE
On the arithmetic frame the value is the
Goldbach statement in its standard form, by
theorem: the sentence is the bit.

RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: WHAT THE NORMAL FORM PROVES ON THE ROW, WITH NO PREMISE
The bit is the act
The transfer holds exactly when the act stands.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Self-recursion
The record is self-recursive with no premise; the
frame exactly when it carries the value.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The bit is keyed
The transfer holds on the calm frame and fails on
the counter frame.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The record decides nothing
Two coherent frames share a record and split on the
value; no principle true of every record decides it.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Every route passes the bit
Any premise that yields the value yields the
transfer, in any vocabulary.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: No uniform answer
Across the frames of the row the transfer is neither
always true nor always false.

svg.text: THE HOST AND THE BINDING, PROVED · PART B OF THE MASTER AND THE MATHLIB BINDING
The binding is a theorem
The value of the arithmetic frame is the Goldbach
statement in its standard form; no reader's
identification stands between.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Every even number has its seat
n = 2k with the mirror fixing k: the one point where
a split and its mirror coincide.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The finite form
A passing check at k proves every even number to
2k a sum of two primes; the statement is exactly a
certificate at every height.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Bound to Mathlib's primes
The kernel's primality is Mathlib's Nat.Prime, and
the kernel's statement is Mathlib's Goldbach
conjecture.

svg.text: The three forms are one
The binary statement is Euler's form, and it gives
the ternary form.

svg.text: The kernel's own computation
Every even number from 4 to 2000 a sum of two
primes, by the kernel's own check, read in the
standard form.
